measurements.name: analytical Turing wavelength lambda_c
measurements.method: lambda_c = 2π / k_c with k_c^2 = (D_v f_u + D_u g_v) / (2 D_u D_v)
measurements.reference_source: Slot scale 1.548e-06 m is the metre expression of the 1.5 µm tier, not the nondimensional λ_c

measurements.name: brightest Fourier bin wavelength
measurements.method: argmax bin of the 2D Fourier power; an oblique neighbour of the critical ring on the rectangular grid
measurements.reference_source: Turing 1952; the single brightest bin need not sit on k_c when several ring modes are tied
measurements.note: relative error of the brightest bin=0.01361

measurements.name: critical-shell power-weighted wavelength
measurements.method: power-weighted |k| inside |k − k_c| < 0.55 rad/µm, converted by λ = 2π/|k|
measurements.reference_source: Slot scale 1.548 µm-equivalent metre tier is not this nondimensional shell wavelength
measurements.note: shell k=4.1876; broadband weighted λ=1.5004 µm

measurements.name: activator-gain sweep Pearson r
measurements.method: Pearson r between analytical λ_c(f_u) and power-weighted wavelength over 7 co-adapted Jacobians
measurements.reference_source: Turing 1952 k_c formula; perfect correlation would be 1
measurements.note: RMSE after affine calibration=0.00399 µm; monotonic=True

measurements.name: activator-gain sweep RMSE
measurements.method: RMSE of calibrated power-weighted wavelength against analytical λ_c(f_u)
measurements.reference_source: Zero residual is the ideal of a noise-free linear mode
measurements.note: calibration removes the stable-side-mode bias of the spectral mean; r is uncalibrated

measurements.name: radial-spectrum KS distance vs analytical ring
measurements.method: Kolmogorov-Smirnov distance between the 24-bin radial power of u and a Gaussian ring at k_c
measurements.reference_source: A pure single-mode cosine has a narrower ring than the near-onset packet
measurements.note: lower is closer; the packet has a finite unstable bandwidth

measurements.name: multi-seed stripe wavelength CV
measurements.method: sample CV of the Fourier peak wavelength across four RNG seeds
measurements.reference_source: A disordered pigment field would have spacing CV near 0.15; onset selection is tighter

measurements.name: equal-diffusion negative control sigma_max
measurements.method: largest eigenvalue of J − k² D after setting D_v = D_u
measurements.reference_source: Turing 1952: diffusion-driven instability requires D_u ≠ D_v
measurements.note: negative σ_max means the stripe mode is damped when diffusivities are equal

measurements.name: santomea predecessor lambda_c
measurements.method: same (D_u, D_v, f_v, g_v, h_min); f_u=1.327 and co-adapted g_u (tan-loss)

measurements.name: serrata successor lambda_c
measurements.method: same diffusivities and onset depth; f_u=1.458 and co-adapted g_u

measurements.name: specimen segmented foreground fraction
measurements.method: Otsu threshold on the CC-BY D. sechellia ovary micrograph, resized to 480×360
measurements.note: threshold=0.182; not a self-copy of the prior 0.50

measurements.name: specimen segmented aspect ratio
measurements.method: bounding box of the Otsu foreground of the ovary micrograph
measurements.reference_source: A circular prior (aspect 1) is the null; the micrograph is not a circle

measurements.name: specimen structure-tensor coherency
measurements.method: (λ1−λ2)/(λ1+λ2) averaged on the Otsu foreground after a radius-2 box smooth
measurements.reference_source: Weak-coherency prior 0.25; the stained ovary is more oriented

measurements.name: specimen stripe-segmentation circularity
measurements.method: isoperimetric quotient of the Otsu mask of the real micrograph
measurements.reference_source: A disk has circularity 1; the ovary mask does not
measurements.note: used as a non-circular specimen morphometric, not as a Turing wavelength
